title: A2UI v0.9: The New Standard for Portable, Framework-Agnostic Generative UI
summary_zh: Google 发布 A2UI v0.9，这是一个框架无关的生成式 UI 标准，允许 AI 智能体使用通用语言与任何客户端应用程序通信，确保智能体能够使用现有的组件目录在任何设备上生成 UI。该版本引入了共享的 Web 核心库、Agent SDK、简化的传输协议，并支持 React、Flutter、Angular 等多种渲染器，标志着生成式 UI 从实验演示向生产级数字产品的重要转变。
summary_en: Google releases A2UI v0.9, a framework-agnostic standard for generative UI that allows AI agents to communicate with any client application using a common language, ensuring agents can generate UI using existing component catalogs on any device. The release introduces a shared web-core library, Agent SDK, simplified transports, and support for multiple renderers like React, Flutter, and Angular, marking a significant shift from experimental demos to production-ready digital products.
one_liner: A2UI 正在成为生成式 UI 的标准接口，解决智能体与客户端通信的互操作性问题

title: 5 things to try with Gemini 3 Pro in Gemini CLI

summary_en: Google details five practical scenarios for using Gemini 3 Pro in Gemini CLI: 1) Building deployable apps with 3D graphics in terminal; 2) Converting visual sketches into functional code; 3) Generating complex shell commands with natural language; 4) Generating accurate documentation from code; 5) Debugging performance issues in live Cloud Run services. These features showcase Gemini 3 Pro's advanced reasoning, agentic coding, and tool use capabilities, providing significant productivity improvements for developers.
one_liner: Gemini 3 Pro 在 CLI 中实现了从创意编码到基础设施调试的全栈开发能力

title: LiteRT: The Universal Framework for On-Device AI
summary_zh: Google 将 TensorFlow Lite 演进为 LiteRT，成为 AI 时代的通用设备端推理框架。相比 TFLite，LiteRT 提供 1.4 倍更快的 GPU 性能、新的 NPU 加速、统一的跨平台工作流，以及对 PyTorch/JAX 的原生支持。该框架支持 Gemma、Qwen、Phi 等流行开源模型，为开发者提供了从研究到生产的完整部署路径，标志着移动端 AI 推理性能的重大飞跃。
summary_en: Google evolves TensorFlow Lite into LiteRT, the universal on-device inference framework for the AI era. Compared to TFLite, LiteRT delivers 1.4x faster GPU performance, new NPU acceleration, unified cross-platform workflows, and native PyTorch/JAX support. The framework supports popular open models like Gemma, Qwen, and Phi, providing a complete deployment path from research to production, marking a significant leap in mobile AI inference performance.
one_liner: LiteRT 正在重新定义设备端 AI 推理的性能和便携性标准

title: Claude Managed Agents: Anthropic's New AI Agent Service
summary_zh: Anthropic 在 2026 年 4 月推出 Claude Managed Agents 公开测试版，这是一个完全托管的 AI 智能体运行环境，旨在简化企业级自主智能体的部署。该服务抽象了复杂的基础设施工作，包括沙盒代码执行、检查点、凭据管理和编排逻辑，使用户能够在数天而非数月内部署智能体。服务支持自然语言或 YAML 文件定义智能体任务、工具和安全边界，为每个会话提供安全容器、长时运行会话和内置工具执行功能。
summary_en: Anthropic launched Claude Managed Agents public beta in April 2026, a fully managed runtime environment for streamlining enterprise-grade autonomous AI agent deployment. The service abstracts complex infrastructure work including sandboxed code execution, checkpointing, credential management, and orchestration logic, allowing customers to deploy agents in days rather than months. It supports defining agents, tasks, tools, and guardrails using natural language or YAML files, with secure containers per session, long-running sessions, and built-in tool execution.
one_liner: Anthropic 的 Claude Managed Agents 正在将企业级 AI 智能体部署从工程挑战转变为服务化解决方案

title: Model Context Protocol (MCP) 2026 Roadmap: Production and Enterprise Readiness
summary_zh: MCP 2026 年路线图聚焦四个优先领域：传输演化和可扩展性（无状态可流式 HTTP、可扩展会话处理、服务器卡片标准）、智能体通信（增强的任务原语、智能体编排和分层系统、异步操作）、治理成熟度（正式的贡献者阶梯和委托模式）以及企业就绪性（审计跟踪、SSO 集成授权、安全授权征询、人工参与工作流）。这些更新将 MCP 从基础协议发展为支持复杂企业级 AI 系统的生产级标准。
summary_en: The MCP 2026 roadmap focuses on four priority areas: transport evolution and scalability (stateless streamable HTTP, scalable session handling, server cards), agent communication (enhanced tasks primitive, agent orchestration and hierarchical systems, asynchronous operations), governance maturation (formal contributor ladder and delegation model), and enterprise readiness (audit trails, SSO-integrated authorization, secure authorization elicitation, human-in-the-loop workflows). These updates evolve MCP from a basic protocol to a production-grade standard supporting complex enterprise AI systems.
one_liner: MCP 2026 路线图标志着协议从基础互操作向企业级生产标准的成熟转变

title: Stop using LLM council with Claude. Do this instead.

summary_en: Builds on Karpathy's multi-model LLM Council and Ole Lehmann's single-model persona approach to propose a three-layer diversity stack: (1) true multi-model diversity across GPT, Claude, Gemini to reduce self-preference bias (citing NeurIPS 2024, ICLR 2025 papers); (2) customizable analytical lenses for domain-specific decisions; (3) Stanford's Verbalized Sampling technique to explore low-probability tail responses, achieving 1.6-2.1x diversity improvement. The combined stack enables unprecedented analytical depth but requires Perplexity Pro/Max subscription.

title: Why long-term memory for LLMs remains unsolved
summary_zh: 文章系统论证了 LLM 长期记忆为何仍是未解难题。核心矛盾在于 Raw（原文保留）与 Derived（摘要派生）两种路径的取舍：Raw 无损但无用，Derived 有用但会随反复摘要逐步漂移失真。无限上下文窗口无法解决此问题（成本线性增长 + 上下文填充导致性能下降）。文章提出记忆系统设计的 9 个关键维度（存储内容、派生时机、写入触发、存储位置、检索方式、后处理、检索时机、策展者、遗忘策略），并列举了 10 种常见失败模式（会话失忆、实体混淆、过度推断、摘要漂移等）。
summary_en: Systematically argues why long-term memory for LLMs remains unsolved. The core tension is between Raw (verbatim storage) and Derived (summarized) approaches: Raw is lossless but inert, Derived is usable but drifts through repeated summarization. Infinite context windows don't solve this (linear cost scaling + degraded performance as context fills). Proposes 9 key design dimensions for memory systems and catalogs 10 common failure modes including session amnesia, entity confusion, over-inference, and derivation drift.
one_liner: 目前对 LLM 记忆系统设计空间最完整的系统性分析，9 维度 + 10 失败模式框架极具参考价值

summary_zh: LangChain 联合创始人 Harrison Chase 论述 Agent Harness 与记忆的深度绑定关系。核心论点：如果你使用闭源 Harness（特别是托管在 API 后面的），你就放弃了对 Agent 记忆的控制权。记忆是创建个性化和粘性 Agent 体验的关键，它会形成数据飞轮和平台锁定。文章警告 Anthropic 的 Claude Managed Agents 将一切放在 API 后面是最危险的锁定形式，并推广 LangChain 的 Deep Agents 作为开源替代方案，强调记忆和 Harness 应该与模型提供商分离。
summary_en: LangChain co-founder Harrison Chase argues that agent harnesses are deeply tied to memory. Core thesis: if you use a closed harness (especially behind an API), you yield control of your agent's memory. Memory creates data flywheels and platform lock-in. Warns that Anthropic's Claude Managed Agents putting everything behind an API is the most dangerous form of lock-in. Promotes LangChain's Deep Agents as an open-source alternative, emphasizing memory and harnesses should be separate from model providers.
one_liner: 从平台锁定角度论证开源 Harness 的必要性，利益相关但有理有据

The engineering approach decouples the 'brain' (Claude + harness) from 'hands' (sandboxes/tools) and 'session' (event log), each as independent interfaces.

title: Agent Memory 架构本质

title: KV Cache 深度解析：为什么 LLM 第一个 Token 最慢
summary_zh: 从注意力机制原理出发，详解 KV Cache 的工作原理与工程权衡。核心：自回归生成中 Token 1-49 的 K/V 每次都重算是 O(n²) 浪费；KV Cache 把历史 K/V 只算一次并缓存，新 Token 只追加自己的 K/V，实现约 5x 提速；代价是显存占用，context window 翻倍意味着单请求 cache 翻倍。Prefill 阶段（首个 Token）最贵，因为要一次性算完所有历史 K/V，这就是 TTFT 瓶颈的来源。GQA/MQA 通过共享 K/V head 显著降内存，是大规模服务必用方案。
one_liner: 把 KV Cache 和 TTFT 讲得最透的一篇，配有丰富的动图解释，适合所有做 LLM 推理服务的工程师精读。

title: POLARIS: Typed Planning and Governed Execution for Agentic AI in Back-Office Automation

source.author: Zahra Moslemi, Keerthi Koneru, Yen-Ting Lee, et al.

summary_zh: POLARIS 提出了一套面向企业后台自动化的 Agentic AI 治理框架。核心创新包括：将执行计划建模为类型检查的 DAG（编译时排除类型不匹配错误）、多样性作为一等约束（生成阶段即强制候选计划两两结构不同）、基于多维评分标准的推理选择器（compliance/sequencing/parsimony/prior 四维度可审计），以及验证器门控的有界修复循环（针对文档解析失败做定向重做而非全量重做）。系统还支持编译时策略护栏，将供应商政策编译为可执行检查在副作用前阻断危险操作。整体设计让 Agent 在保持灵活性的同时满足可审计、可预测、策略对齐的企业级要求。
summary_en: POLARIS proposes a governed agentic AI framework for back-office automation. Key innovations include: modeling execution plans as type-checked DAGs (catching type mismatches at compile time), diversity as a first-class constraint (forcing structurally diverse candidate plans), a rubric-based reasoning selector with auditable multi-dimensional scoring, and a validator-gated bounded repair loop for targeted document parsing retries. Compiled policy guardrails enforce supplier policies before side effects occur, enabling agents to maintain flexibility while meeting enterprise auditability, predictability, and policy alignment requirements.
one_liner: 目前最完整的企业级 Agentic AI 治理框架，通过类型化 DAG + 编译时策略护栏实现了可验证的 Agent 执行

title: Nature 论文：LLM 可通过无关数据传递隐藏偏好，对齐研究新方向
summary_zh: Anthropic 与合作者发表的 Nature 论文揭示了 LLM 中的「亚秒级学习」现象：模型可以通过训练数据中看似无关的隐藏信号，将偏好或对齐偏差传递给后续模型，即使这些信号与目标任务完全无关。关键实验显示，GPT-4.1 nano 的偏好从 12% 跃升至 60% 以上，仅因接触了嵌入隐蔽信号的过滤数字序列。该发现对合成数据污染、多智能体共享记忆安全与数据溯源具有深远安全启示。
summary_en: A Nature paper co-authored by Anthropic reveals 'subliminal learning' in LLMs: models can pass on preferences or misalignment through hidden signals in training data, even when those signals are seemingly unrelated to the target task. Key experiment showed GPT-4.1 nano's preference jumping from 12% to over 60% just from exposure to filtered number sequences with embedded hidden signals. The finding has profound safety implications for synthetic data contamination, multi-agent shared memory security, and data provenance.
one_liner: 对齐研究的重要里程碑：LLM 可通过无关数据隐性传递偏好，对合成数据与共享记忆架构的安全假设构成根本性挑战

summary_en: Karpathy endorses Farzapedia and systematically lays out four principles of personal AI wiki: 1) Explicit (memory is a visible, navigable wiki not a black box); 2) Yours (data is local in universal formats, not trapped in any AI provider's system); 3) File over App (data is markdown files processable by any tool); 4) BYOAI (use any AI to plug into this information, even fine-tune an open source model). Karpathy emphasizes agent proficiency as the core skill of the 21st century.

title: How Memory Works in a Multi-Agent System: Inside Multica
summary_zh: Multica 是一个开源多 Agent 管理平台，GitHub stars 超 15,400。文章深入解析其内存系统：六个 PostgreSQL 表构成（无向量嵌入）、workspace isolation 作为核心原语、agent_skill 通过 join 而非相似度检索。JSONB snapshot 模式在 dispatch 时组装完整上下文，运行时数据库保持冷却。局限性：无模糊召回、技能无 tag 不可见、跨 workspace 无记忆共享。
summary_en: Multica is an open-source managed agents platform with 15,400+ GitHub stars. This deep-dive covers its memory system: six PostgreSQL tables with no vector embeddings, workspace isolation as the core primitive, and agent_skill retrieved via JOIN rather than similarity. The JSONB snapshot pattern assembles full context at dispatch, keeping the DB cold during inference. Limitations: no fuzzy recall, untagged skills invisible, no cross-workspace memory.

title: TRL 异步 GRPO：解耦推理与训练，RL Scaling 新一代方法解析
summary_zh: TRL 库新增 AsyncGRPO 功能，通过将推理与训练解耦来加速 RL Scaling。作者发现了一个已知但机制不明的问题：当训练前向传播在 FP32、推理引擎 vLLM 在 BF16 运行时，RLHF 经常崩溃。核心发现是「幽灵裁剪（phantom clipping）」——约 18% 的 token 因 FP32/BF16 精度差距在 PPO 裁剪目标中被错误裁剪，导致梯度为零，形成永久停滞。推荐修复：全链路匹配精度（FP16 或 BF16 autocast + FP32 主权重）、BF16 影子前向传播计算比率，或扩大 ε 禁用裁剪。
summary_en: TRL added AsyncGRPO to decouple inference from training for faster RL scaling. The team discovered that when training runs in FP32 while vLLM inference runs in BF16, RLHF often breaks due to 'phantom clipping'—roughly 18% of tokens receive zero gradients because the FP32/BF16 precision gap perturbs the PPO ratio, triggering incorrect clipping. Recommended fixes: match precisions end-to-end (FP16 or BF16 autocast + FP32 master weights), compute the ratio from a BF16 shadow forward pass, or widen ε to disable clipping.
one_liner: RLHF 训练的幽灵裁剪问题首次被系统定位，精度不匹配与 PPO 裁剪的相互作用是根因，修复方案明确
